surface_definition.tau: tau_h(theta_p, theta_s) = sum over CHOSEN muscles of computeMomentArm(about the PRIMARY dof) x Fmax; OpenSim native signs (arm = -dL/dq; tau>0 = positive coordinate direction; knee flexion NEGATIVE: vasti positive / hamstrings negative)
surface_definition.grid: 5x5 INCLUSIVE uniform nodes per axis over rom_table_deg (theta_i = lo + (hi-lo)*i/4); 25 cells per actuator; grading values are DIRECT OpenSim evaluations at the nodes (never interpolated); cell bin = midpoint-Voronoi interval within [lo, hi] (outer bins half-width)
surface_definition.area_share: headline metric is AREA SHARE over the graded cells (see FIX_SPEC 1 phrasing style); envelope-excluded cells are removed from the denominator for BOTH rows and never counted as failures
surface_definition.standing_trap: human surfaces computed on STOCK gait2392_simbody routing only; robot/BPA paths never substituted

hip_adduction_envelope.rule: adduction max = 20 deg at flexion -15 tapering LINEARLY to +10 deg at flexion +110; abduction max from -10 deg at full extension to -60 deg at full flexion; LINEAR interpolation between extremes (supersedes the 2026-10-22 quarter-ellipse placeholder)
hip_adduction_envelope.physical_origin: BONE INTERFERENCE (femur-pelvis contact, per Ben) - a real anatomical/hardware constraint, not a modeling convenience
hip_adduction_envelope.cell_rule: cell graded iff its CENTER (p_node, s_node) is inside the closed envelope
hip_adduction_envelope.hip_rotation: stays the static rom_table_deg box until Ben rules otherwise; pinned at 0 on actuator 24 (not graded anywhere)
hip_adduction_envelope.tfl_note: actuator 7 grades knee x hip_flexion; its hip_adduction (2nd map secondary) is PINNED AT 0, which is inside the envelope at every graded flexion, so no envelope exclusion applies to its surface

pinning_3plus_joint_routes.1: lumbar_rotation pinned at 0 (grades lumbar_extension x lumbar_bending)

uniarticular_class_serving.note: FIX_SPEC 1: the BiPam class serves uniarticular muscles over its two hinges; the five actuators whose map entry lists no secondary grade on their CLASS hinge pair
uniarticular_class_serving.12: ankle_angle_r x knee_angle_r (Calves thetaKneeAnkle; human soleus is knee-independent so its surface is flat in knee)
uniarticular_class_serving.26: hip_flexion_r x hip_adduction_r (Uni_Hip two-hinge pair; envelope-coupled)

flag_layer.policy: flagged cells STILL COUNT in the headline meet percentage (conservative); with-flag and without-flag numbers are BOTH reported; curves are NEVER corrected
flag_layer.FLAG_VIA: ConditionalPathPoint isActive-set change inside the cell bin; 0.5-deg cross sweeps (primary swept at each secondary node and vice versa); boundary is a constant-angle line (checklist-verified)
flag_layer.FLAG_STEP: adjacent-sample |d(arm)| > 2.0% of the per-muscle SURFACE-WIDE peak A* (never per-column); 0.5-deg cross sweeps
flag_layer.FLAG_SLACK: any 1-deg full-box sample in the cell bin with l_mt <= tendon_slack_length
flag_layer.FLAG_SHORT: any 1-deg full-box sample in the cell bin with lceN_est < 0.5 (constant-width pennation estimate, lce = sqrt((l_mt-tsl)^2 + (lo sin phi0)^2); upper bound on true fiber length when tendon is loaded)
flag_layer.FLAG_BONE: NOT APPLIED - bone-penetration check TODO and not run (checklist L5); disclosed here, no flags invented
flag_layer.audit_caveats: the 1-D audit of record (path_artifact_audit_...034030.csv) primary-DOF caveat strings are carried per actuator in the grading CSV column audit_caveat_1d_primary

halt_gates.live_wrap_sets: empty on every chosen muscle: PASS
halt_gates.fd: non-knee primary moment-arm FD (5% tol): PASS; knee informational per documented wrap/moving-point nonsmoothness

viewing_export.method: bilinear interpolation from the 1-deg OpenSim box samples; grading values in the 5x5 CSV are direct evaluations; interpolation smooths via-point discontinuities for VIEWING only

reporting.headline: robot-row meet percentages computed against tau_h_Nm in the 5x5 CSV count FLAGGED cells (conservative)
reporting.without_flag_variant: meet percentage over graded cells with no flags (denominator = n_graded_cells - n_flagged_graded_cells per actuator)
